description: This file provides helper functions and constants for initializing and displaying notifications during background sync work in an Android application. It defines constraints for network connectivity required for sync operations, creates notification channels for lower API levels, and provides a method to generate a foreground info object with an associated notification.

classes.name: ForegroundInfo
classes.description: A class representing foreground service information, including notification details to run a background task with foreground priority.

methods.name: syncWorkNotification
methods.description: Creates and returns a notification object to indicate ongoing sync work, setting up a notification channel for API levels >= Oreo.
